verses.text: The family line began with Adam, Seth, and Enosh,
then Kenan, Mahalalel, and Jared,
then Enoch, Methuselah, and Lamech,
then Noah and his sons Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
Japheth's sons were Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
Gomer's sons were Ashkenaz, Diphath, and Togarmah.
Javan's sons were Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.
Ham's sons were Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
Cush's sons were Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raama, and Sabteca. Raamah's sons were Sheba and Dedan.
Cush was also Nimrod's father. Nimrod rose to become a mighty man on earth.
Mizraim was the ancestor of the Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,
as well as the Pathrusim, the Casluhim, from whom the Philistines came, and the Caphtorim.
Canaan was the father of Sidon, his firstborn, and Heth. He was also the ancestor of
the Jebusites, Amorites, and Girgashites,
the Hivites, Arkites, and Sinites,
and the Arvadites, Zemarites, and Hamathites.
Shem's descendants were Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.
Arpachshad was Shelah's father, and Shelah was Eber's father.
Eber had two sons. One was named Peleg because the earth was divided in his time. His brother was named Joktan.
Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
Hadoram, Uzal, and Diklah,
Ebal, Abimael, and Sheba,
and Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. These were all Joktan's sons.
The family line went from Shem to Arpachshad and Shelah,
then Eber, Peleg, and Reu,
then Serug, Nahor, and Terah,
then Abram, who was also called Abraham.
Abraham's sons were Isaac and Ishmael.
These were Ishmael's descendants: Nebaioth was his firstborn, followed by Kedar, Adbeel, and Mibsam,
then Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,
and Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These were Ishmael's sons.
Abraham's concubine Keturah gave birth to Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. Jokshan's sons were Sheba and Dedan.
Midian's sons were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were Keturah's descendants.
Abraham was Isaac's father. Isaac's sons were Esau and Israel.
Esau's sons were Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
Eliphaz's descendants were Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, and Amalek.
Reuel's sons were Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
Seir's sons were Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
Lotan's sons were Hori and Homam. Timna was Lotan's sister.
Shobal's sons were Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. Zibeon's sons were Aiah and Anah.
Anah's son was Dishon. Dishon's sons were Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
Ezer's sons were Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. Dishan's sons were Uz and Aran.
These were the kings who ruled Edom before Israel had a king. The first was Bela son of Beor, whose city was Dinhabah.
When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah took his place.
When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites took his place.
When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad took his place. Hadad defeated Midian in the fields of Moab, and his city was Avith.
When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah took his place.
When Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth by the River took his place.
When Shaul died, Baal Hanan son of Achbor took his place.
When Baal Hanan died, Hadad took his place. His city was Pai. His wife was Mehetabel daughter of Matred and granddaughter of Mezahab.
Then Hadad died. These were Edom's chiefs: Timna, Aliah, and Jetheth,
Oholibamah, Elah, and Pinon,
Kenaz, Teman, and Mibzar,
and Magdiel and Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom.
